name: 922 Difficulty Stamper
description: Scans a 922 batch's part drawings for the DriveWorks DIFFICULT label and stamps DIFFICULT on that order's work packet. Re-running keeps packets honest: an order that is no longer difficult has its stamp removed.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '922 QTDR Production Packages' folder.
The parts must already be modeled - the app reads the part drawings under each order's CAD-AND-SHOP-PRINTS folder. Orders that aren't modeled yet are reported and skipped.
Close the work-packet PDFs if they're open in a viewer, so they can be re-saved with the stamp.
how_it_works: For each order it reads every part drawing under CAD-AND-SHOP-PRINTS and looks for the DIFFICULT label DriveWorks prints on parts with a compound cut.
If any part in the order is difficult, it stamps DIFFICULT in red on the first page of that order's work packet.
If an order was stamped before but none of its parts are difficult any more, the old stamp is removed.
output: Work packets stamped DIFFICULT, plus a summary listing which orders are difficult and which parts made them difficult.
